rationale: Provides comprehensive data anonymization techniques (k-anonymity, differential privacy, generalization) to grant third-party researchers privacy-preserving dataset access.
Enables de-identification and re-identification risk analysis to preserve training data privacy during external audits.
Evaluates residual privacy risks (singling out, linkability, inference) in synthetic datasets to ensure privacy compliance before third-party researcher access.
Provides attack-based statistical assessments to measure and verify privacy preservation in synthetic training data for external audits.
Implements differentially private training (DP-SGD with ghost clipping) for transformer models to prevent the extraction and memorization of sensitive training data.
Enables differentially private model training that preserves training data privacy when models are shared for external auditing.
Implements differentially private generative models (PATE-GAN, DP-WGAN) to generate DP synthetic datasets shareable with third-party researchers.
Generates differentially private synthetic data to enable privacy-preserving external audits of training datasets.
Implements multiple machine unlearning algorithms (gradient ascent/descent variants) to remove sensitive concepts and training data from pre-trained LLMs.
Provides evaluation benchmarks across diverse domain datasets (arXiv, books, code) to measure unlearning completeness and model performance.
Optimizes unlearning efficiency to be over 10^5 times faster than retraining while preserving overall language model capability.
Provides GPU-accelerated pipelines and classifiers to filter, clean, and verify large training datasets to remove toxic, harmful, and prohibited material.
Provides anonymization techniques (k-anonymity, l-diversity, t-closeness, blurring, redaction) across tabular, text, image, and audio datasets for privacy-preserving researcher access.
Enables multi-modal data anonymization to preserve training data privacy while allowing external auditing.
Implements a layer-wise deletion operator to remove specific nodes and edges from trained graph neural networks.
Provides an efficient unlearning method for GNNs that deletes target graph data via latent updates without degrading overall model utility.
Provides benchmark datasets and evaluation protocols to test and verify the completeness of machine unlearning in identity-forgetting tasks.
Implements the Aug-PE algorithm to generate differentially private synthetic text, enabling privacy-preserving dataset access for third-party researchers.
Implements differentially private Graph Neural Network training via aggregation perturbation to prevent the extraction of private training graph data.
